name: 新 HSK 七—九级（3.0）
note: New HSK (3.0) advanced paper from the official 2026 sample: 91 questions, about 200 minutes. One paper covers levels 7, 8 and 9 (the level is awarded from the score), so no pass mark or total is shown. Section scores out of 100 and the writing and translation weights are estimates; the scoring has not been published. Oral translation (85–86) and speaking (87–91) are practice only.

sections.name: 听力 Listening
sections.intro: 大家好！欢迎参加HSK七到九级考试。听力考试分三部分，共40题。请大家注意，听力考试现在开始。

parts.title: 第一部分
parts.desc: 第1～10题：请根据听到的内容，判断下列句子是否符合原文。符合原文的选“√”，不符合原文的选“×”，原文没提到的选“〇”。
parts.audioIntro: 第一部分，第1到10题。请根据听到的内容，判断句子是否符合原文。每段新闻听一次。
parts.rangeIntro: 第{a}到{b}题是根据下面一段新闻。

parts.title: 第二部分
parts.desc: 第11～22题：请选出或填上正确答案。
parts.audioIntro: 第二部分，第11到22题。请选出或填上正确答案。每段对话听一次。
parts.rangeIntro: 第{a}到{b}题是根据下面一段对话。

parts.title: 第三部分
parts.desc: 第23～40题：请选出或填上正确答案。
parts.audioIntro: 第三部分，第23到40题。请选出或填上正确答案。每段话听一次。
parts.rangeIntro: 第{a}到{b}题是根据下面一段话。

parts.title: 第二部分
parts.desc: 第62～66题：请将下列段落重新排序，组成一篇完整的文章。其中一个段落为干扰项，需排除；一个段落的位置已经给出。

parts.fillHint: 十个字以内 · at most 10 characters
parts.title: 第三部分
parts.desc: 第67～80题：请回答下面的问题，注意答案要控制在十个字以内。

parts.title: 第一部分
parts.desc: 第81题：请对图表进行描述与分析，写一篇不少于200字的文章（建议15分钟）。
parts.rubric:
Score 0-40 (HSK 7-9 chart description and analysis, at least 200 characters; count every character incl. punctuation). Look at the chart image first.
36-40 = accurately describes the main features of the chart (highest/lowest, comparisons, trends) with correct figures, adds a sensible analysis or conclusion; well organised; precise, formal advanced vocabulary; almost no errors
28-35 = covers the main features with mostly correct figures and some analysis; minor errors
20-27 = describes only part of the chart or merely lists numbers without comparison/analysis; several errors
10-19 = misreads the chart or is far too short (under 150 characters) or has many errors
1-9 = very little relevant, correct Chinese
0 = blank or not Chinese
Deduct 1 per wrongly written character (max 5).

parts.title: 第二部分
parts.desc: 第82题：话题作文，写一篇不少于600字的文章，论证你的观点（建议40分钟）。
parts.rubric:
Score 0-60 (HSK 7-9 argumentative essay, at least 600 characters; count every character incl. punctuation):
54-60 = clear thesis answering the prompt; rigorous, well-developed arguments with evidence and examples, considers counter-arguments; coherent structure; rich, precise, formal advanced vocabulary (idioms, written-style connectives) and complex sentences; almost no errors
42-53 = clear position and reasonable arguments; good organisation; advanced vocabulary with some errors that do not hinder understanding
30-41 = position stated but arguments thin or partly off-topic; plain vocabulary; noticeable errors
15-29 = unclear position or under 450 characters or many errors
1-14 = very little relevant, correct Chinese
0 = blank or not Chinese
Deduct 1 per wrongly written character (max 5).

parts.title: 第一部分
parts.desc: 第83～84题：请将下列两篇材料译写成中文（限时35分钟）。
parts.rubric:
Score 0-50 (HSK 7-9 written translation, English into Chinese). Compare with the English `source`; `model` is one good translation, not the only one.
45-50 = complete and accurate; natural, idiomatic written Chinese with appropriate advanced vocabulary and sentence structure; almost no errors
35-44 = meaning conveyed with minor omissions or inaccuracies; mostly natural Chinese; a few errors
25-34 = main ideas conveyed but several mistranslations, omissions or awkward word-for-word renderings
10-24 = large parts missing or mistranslated; many language errors
1-9 = very little correct, relevant Chinese
0 = blank or not Chinese
Deduct 1 per wrongly written character (max 5).

speaking.name: 口译与口语 Interpreting & Speaking
speaking.note: Practice only, not scored: questions 85–91 of the paper (oral translation, then speaking; about 25 minutes). Your answers are recorded in this browser only.

parts.title: 翻译·第二部分
parts.desc: 第85～86题：口译。阅读材料一分钟，然后口头译成中文。

parts.title: 口语·第三部分
parts.desc: 第91题：观点表达。听材料，准备三分钟，然后表达你的观点。
